Shipped v28.96 (cw-headbars). The ship gate passed, and the seed 4242 fingerprint held at ents 85/374 and containers 165/593.

His order was that the reload bar and the other bars above the head are never blocked by buildings. The heal and plate bar over the player's head was the only one that could be covered. It was drawn before the depth-sorted pass, so a wall in front of the player hid it. I moved it into the world text pass, which draws after every wall.

The reload, search, revive and downed bars were already drawn on the HUD, on top of everything. I left them as they were.

The new check hooks `fillRect` while a heal is applying. It confirms the bar is drawn from `_wtA` and not from the sorted pass. I didn't run it against the old build to see it fail, only the preflight and the real gate on the new one.

I marked head bars DONE in `notes/evening.md`. The next open item is the barrel fire damage over time.

TASK DONE
